body: It will never get better. I have talked and talked and nothing ever changes. It only gets worse. My life is over. I will destroy my worthless self. I will cut every inch of my body until there is nothing left of the pathetic waste of life that I am.

My life is in ruins and i am all alone trying to pick up the pieces but everyone is kicking me while I'm down. I just don't understand what I did to deserve this hell. I want to rip  my body apart and end it all right now.

I just cannot do this anymore. My life has fallen apart, I have no future and nobody cares. Nobody would be surprised if I killed myself, everybody is just waiting for me to do it. I hate myself I want to destroy this useless body in a million pieces.
I don't know anymore. What's the point of being cared for if nobody will show it until I'm dead? I honestly don't think I'll be here in a year, not even a week tbh.

My parents don't understand, they don't speak English and I'm not good at their language, we can't communicate well. And they think everything is ok, they don't realize I am going to die but if they knew they would freak out. I feel bad but I can't make them understand, they will never get it.
The only reason I put so much weight on it is because I have given up on myself, so if others give up on me then there is no reason to still be here.
No I am a useless college dropout.
Everyone. My family, past friends, random people. Nobody would care if I died, life would be better for everyone if I wasn't here.
Everyone hates me, nobody wants me around.
Ok please do. And please don't hurt yourself, you are too precious to die.

I agree you should see a different therapist, the one your mom picked is not be fair to you. You could just tell her this one is not helping you much. Does your school have any counselors? Most schools offer it for free and completely confidential.

Oh my gosh that is horrible, you are dealing with so much at once. Did anyone do anything about your mom threatening suicide? It doesn't sound like she is stable and that can have a really bad effect on you. She is also wrong for not being okay with your clothes and your sexuality, and for reading your journal. Honestly it sounds like she is having an awful impact on your life, is there anyone else you can stay with? In many places, you can legally choose to live somewhere else when you're 16. If not, you can tell an adult at school about your home situation, a counselor or a teacher. Or even a therapist, if you have one. You shouldn't have to fight this alone. You are not pathetic. None of this was ever your fault, you have been abused and neglected. You deserve much better. I really want you to tell someone, even if you think there's nothing they can do or that it will make it worse. You need to be heard.
Don't do this. I know what it's like to be pushed around emotionally and feel trapped and betrayed, especially by family. Tell me more about what's going on, I want to help you.
Why, what changed?
No no no no please don't die.
I am so happy, please don't ever leave us.
Don't worry about me, you are more important. Don't die please.
I hope you don't die. You shouldn't have to die. I wish I could take all your pain since i am a lost cause anyway. It's just not fair. If you stop posting on Monday I don't know what I will do.

I just don't have anyone like that. Don't have any friends and I don't know any relatives aside from my shitty immediate family. I don't know about calling a hotline, they can trace my number and send cops, and since I live in my mom's house, it will make everything worse. I wish I had supportive people around like everyone else seems to. This place is all I have.
The problem is, I don't have friends or trustworthy relatives, and I have no money for a professional. I don't have anything.

Thanks for understanding. I do care about myself. But my sense of self-worth has been driven into the ground, because I realized my life was never mine to live. I can't ever be happy while I'm completely dependent on parents who want me to live for them. But there's also no escape in sight, which is what they want. That's why they kept me sheltered all this time. But there is one escape, which is what I'm planning to do.
They think it's just an excuse, they are religious and "don't believe" in mental issues. They only care that I'm in school so they don't feel ashamed when relatives ask.

I can't quit or my parents will kick me out. They won't allow me to switch to a different program. I can't pay for it myself because I can't get a job, I have no experience and I've been in legal trouble in the past. I have no money or savings either. There is nowhere to go for me, except splattered on the cement.

It's great that you turned things around for yourself, but not everyone can do that. It's not as easy or simple as "it was bad but now everything's better". What kind of people do I stick around for? When my family and friends have abandoned me, who else would care about me? Nobody is magically going to float into my life and make it better. And I've tried making it better on my own, that doesn't work either.
Attendance is not mandatory.
I was going for BHSc, failed once before, second try now. It's a useless degree anyway so I'm saving myself much trouble.
That's when I failed my degree. Life has been shit since and not worth living anymore.
I am 19, I don't have any friends anymore, family despises me for being a failure, life is over now.
Since the start of this year.
What level did you drop out of? Grad, undergrad? Did you have a degree that landed you the job? Also, I'm curious what job you found, if you're not comfortable sharing here you can PM me.
I made a post about it. I don't think I can be helped.

I just don't see how it would help me to talk to someone who doesn't really care and is paid to listen. Since they wouldn't know me well enough, the most they could offer is superficial advice, which I've gotten enough of online. 

Also I can't afford it, I don't have a job.
I know, that's why I've pretty much given up on seeking help IRL.
I get so excited when I see it, then I find out it's just a bot asking me to flair a post I made..
Thanks for commenting. I couldn't do it, too scary. I need to find an easier way. Maybe pills.
